_source: Korg MS-10 service manual, circuit diagram p.4 (IC16 KORG35 and surroundings)
_R62: from C19 to the VR13 wiper, across the top section of the pot
_assumed: KORG35 internals: two BJT diff-pair transconductors (no internal attenuation), pin 7 = unity buffer of the C13 node, matched-pair expo converter. fn0 = self-oscillation frequency at cv=0, from adjustment procedure 7-4 (cutoff knob 5 -> 500 Hz).
